title: VPN disconnects every few minutes

The technician restored the approved 30-minute idle timeout and reloaded the gateway and confirmed the session remained connected beyond the previous five-minute failure interval; added a configuration check to the maintenance checklist.
resolution_steps: 1. Reproduced report 1 in the demo environment. 2. Inspected the relevant logs and configuration. 3. Restored the approved 30-minute idle timeout and reloaded the gateway. 4. Confirmed the session remained connected beyond the previous five-minute failure interval. 5. Asked the reporter to confirm recovery.
